covered_report_window: U.S.-listed companies reporting after the U.S. market close on Monday, October 26, 2026, plus companies reporting before the U.S. market open on Tuesday, October 27, 2026.
market_context_summary: U.S. equities were higher intraday, led by technology, but the event backdrop remained fragile: WTI crude was near $101, the 10-year Treasury yield was near 5%, and investors were awaiting Wednesday's Federal Reserve decision amid elevated inflation and heavy earnings volume.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Data-center orders, backlog conversion, FY2027 outlook
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Strong prior run and a merely in-line forward guide

ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Orders slow or guidance implies that backlog and AI-cooling demand convert less quickly than expected.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Shares were about 9% below their 52-week high but still up roughly 20% in 2026, creating a meaningful expectation bar.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: The market bar rose after a fiscal-third-quarter beat and guidance increase; consensus calls for roughly 25% year-over-year EPS growth.
ranked_companies.pass_agreement: All three passes Lean Up; scores 46/41/43
